facts.fact: CISD says it maintains 32 application systems and runs email administration, network administration and database administration for the Civil Service.
CISD, a division of the Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation, says it develops and runs application systems and services for Ministries and Departments.
CISD says its new Government payroll system was developed entirely in-house and went live in July 2024.
CISD says the new Government payroll system was developed entirely in-house, with no supplier named.
CISD says its Application Development Unit fully rolled out the Bad Weather Allowance System for the Ministry of Agro-Industry, with no contractor named.
CISD lists the Flight Clearance system among its 2024 releases, phases 1 to 3 live, with no contractor named.

note: Email was awarded to Mauritius Telecom with Lingora, so not in-house.
